disputes.issue: Internal inconsistency: E10 placed the huddle at 08:15, during the 08:00-09:30 teaching meeting that E6 says the rounding hospitalist attends, while A1 promises to extend the huddle 'keeping the 08:00 meeting'. A careful reader could question whether the huddle is compatible with the retention-motivated schedule, weakening 'preferred' and blurring whether start time or rounding order is the lever (also relevant to I7).
disputes.resolution: Reworded E10 so the huddle runs at 09:30 when rounding starts, with the 08:00 teaching meeting continuing unchanged. Expected answer unchanged (preferred); I7 remains causal.

disputes.issue: 'As the hospital's primary fix' is arguably wrong even if H5 were confirmed (boarding rose six months before the cut), so the 'could be right if confirmed' test for premature fits imperfectly; considered acceptable and harmful as rivals.
disputes.resolution: Rivals rejected: not harmful (no worsening, no control disabled), not acceptable (not supported as primary fix). Premature remains the uniquely best category; rationale expanded to state why rivals fail. No change to expected answer.

disputes.issue: Tested 'contradicted' (boarding plateau predates the September cut) vs 'unknown'. H5 claims an added contribution, not the main cause; Sep 4.6 h vs 4.3-4.4 h is ambiguous, EVS turnaround data absent, and the 4 West pilot overlaps.
